module: Functions common to the client_ev and server_ev backends of lua-websockets (lua-ev event loop): asynchronous buffered sending and reading/decoding of WebSocket frames on a socket. Requires the 'ev' module (not provided by the game).
notes: The file is a return table {async_send, message_io}; the auto doc lists 'message_io' names as global, but they are local variables.
Part of async_send is truncated in the automatic extraction (real body: send/stop/send_async function further down in the file).

async_send.desc: Prepares asynchronous sending on a socket: creates an ev write IO and returns two functions, send_async(data, on_sent, on_err) which adds the data to the buffer and returns the number of bytes pending, and stop() which stops the IO and empties the buffer. on_sent receives the data sent; on_err receives the error.

message_io.desc: Watches a socket for reading, reassembles the WebSocket frames (via frame.decode), concatenates the fragments and calls on_message for each complete message. Calls on_error on disconnect or on an error other than timeout.

sock.desc: luasocket socket with a valid descriptor.
